name_cn: 鲁泰纺织股份有限公司
main_products: Yarn-dyed shirting, cotton shirting and poplin, piece-dyed fabrics, shirts
woven_evidence: Several sources describe it as the world's largest yarn-dyed shirting mill, making 210M+ m of yarn-dyed woven fabric a year.

canton_fair.evidence_note: The China Foreign Trade Center's preview of the 123rd Canton Fair (2018) lists Lu Thai among exhibitors. A third-party jufair.com Phase 3 'known exhibitors' list also names 鲁泰纺织, but gives no session.

notes: A large listed mill (000726.SZ) that supplies premium brands. Its MOQs and prices may be high for KSA buyers. It also makes garments, but fabric is its core business.
